sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_week w USING(week_id) WHERE w.iso_year = 2025
SELECT SUM(m.refill_price_krw) FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_week w USING(week_id) JOIN dim_member m USING(member_id) WHERE w.iso_year = 2025
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM fact_orders WHERE week_id BETWEEN 96 AND 103
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.member_id) FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_member m USING(member_id) WHERE m.region_code='SEL' AND o.week_id BETWEEN 96 AND 103
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_week w ON m.join_week_id = w.week_id WHERE w.iso_year = 2025
SELECT SUM(s.spend_krw) FROM fact_spend s JOIN dim_week w USING(week_id) JOIN dim_channel c USING(channel_code) WHERE w.iso_year = 2025 AND c.is_acquisition

SELECT (SELECT SUM(s.spend_krw) FROM fact_spend s JOIN dim_week w USING(week_id) WHERE w.iso_year = 2025 AND s.region_code='YNG') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_week w ON m.join_week_id = w.week_id WHERE w.iso_year = 2025 AND m.region_code='YNG')
SELECT SUM(f.net_revenue_krw) FROM fact_sellout f JOIN dim_week w USING(week_id) WHERE w.iso_year = 2025 AND w.sellout_complete = 1

SELECT SUM(units_returned)::DOUBLE / SUM(units_sold) FROM fact_sellout f JOIN dim_week w USING(week_id) JOIN dim_product p USING(sku) WHERE w.iso_year = 2025 AND w.sellout_complete = 1 AND p.product_type='Device'
SELECT SUM(messages) FROM fact_crm_messages c JOIN dim_week w USING(week_id) WHERE w.iso_year = 2025 AND c.send_type <> 'suppressed'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_cx_tickets x JOIN dim_week w ON x.created_week_id = w.week_id WHERE w.iso_year = 2025
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN resolution_days <= 3 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM fact_cx_tickets x JOIN dim_week w ON x.created_week_id = w.week_id WHERE w.iso_year = 2025 AND status='Resolved'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE last_order_week_id IS NOT NULL AND last_order_week_id <= 91
SELECT SUM(retained_members)::DOUBLE / MAX(cohort_size) FROM fact_cohort_retention WHERE join_cohort='2024 Q1' AND months_since_join=3
